heading: Frequently Asked Questions
subheading: Everything you need to know before booking

faqs.question: How many events do you organize per month?
faqs.answer: Each month, we organize one free, large social event open to the entire mahjong community, welcoming new attendees. We also organize one special mahjong invitational tournament dedicated to celebrating our most active and deserving members. This tournament recognizes those who have contributed meaningfully to our community and gives them a chance to compete for the title of Player of the Month. In addition to our core community events, we collaborate with a handful of businesses and brands each month to create unique and curated mahjong experiences.

faqs.question: Where do you teach and host events?
faqs.answer: We teach and host events throughout New York City, including Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Queens. You provide the dedicated private or semi-private space, the tables, and the chairs. We'll come to you and bring the mahjong tiles, mats, and instructors.

faqs.question: Do you teach Hong Kong-style or American mahjong?
faqs.answer: We specialize in Hong Kong-style mahjong, which is widely played across Asia and in Chinese diaspora communities. If you've played American mahjong before, we'll happily walk you through the differences.

faqs.question: I'm a business owner or manager interested in collaborating. Where do I begin?
faqs.answer: We’d love to connect! The best way to start is by sending us a DM on Instagram. Drop us a message with a quick intro, and we’ll check out your brand and content to make sure there's great synergy for a joint event. As part of the collaboration, we'll promote your brand through our stories, posts, and reels. Our event content typically draws around 25k views with high engagement metrics (we're happy to share screenshots), giving us a good chance to go viral together. From there, we can chat about potential dates, logistics, and pricing to see how we can bring an incredible experience to life. We're also happy to bring you on as a vendor to our larger events provided that you give out free samples, goods, or services to our guests.

faqs.question: Can I sponsor your events?
faqs.answer: Yes! We love collaborating with brands and local businesses for our free community events. Sponsoring us puts your brand directly in front of a hyper-engaged local audience. Our large social event draws over 300 attendees, and our tournament hosts 20 of our top players every month. In addition to the live activation, we also feature our sponsors on our event flyers and Instagram recaps, where our posts and reels routinely pull around 20k to 30k total views with high engagement and strong viral potential—upwards of 100k+ views. It is the perfect way to gain massive online visibility while aligning your brand with our community and demographic. Send us a DM on Instagram with a quick intro and let’s collaborate to create an incredible experience together!

faqs.question: Can I get a refund?
faqs.answer:
Customers are eligible for a full refund on ticket purchases up to 48 hours before an event begins. Between the 48-hour window and up to 2 hours prior to start time, refunds are subject to our waitlist policy and will only be processed if another attendee on the waitlist takes your spot. Message us on Instagram or email us for a refund. You can also request your own refund automatically if the ticket was purchased on TicketTailor through their platform linked on your ticket email.

All ticket sales after this period are final, non-refundable, and non-transferable for a future event. All other sales including merchandise, private lessons, and corporate workshops are final and non-refundable.
